company.summary: A Suzhou-based decorative material supplier focused on WPC decking, exterior cladding, acoustic slat wall panels, fluted panels, fencing and project-ready composite systems.

hero.kicker: WPC Decking / Acoustic Panels / Decorative Material Systems
hero.title: Factory-direct decorative material systems for exterior and interior projects.
hero.subtitle: We help distributors, contractors and project owners source durable WPC decking, exterior wall cladding, acoustic slat panels and matching decorative profiles from one responsive Suzhou team.

proof.title: Factory coordination
proof.body: Profile matching, sample preparation and project packaging are coordinated around real delivery needs.

proof.title: Sustainable materials
proof.body: Composite wood-plastic and PET-backed decorative systems reduce maintenance and support long service life.

faq.question: What does Hongjuda supply?
faq.answer: Hongjuda supplies WPC decking, exterior cladding, acoustic slat wall panels, fluted decorative panels, privacy fencing and matching composite profiles.

faq.question: Who is the site for?
faq.answer: The site is built for distributors, contractors, designers, builders and project buyers who need factory-direct decorative material sourcing from Suzhou, China.

faq.question: Can products be customized?
faq.answer: Customization can include color, profile, length, packaging, sample sets and project documentation depending on product type and order quantity.
